slides.label: Overview
slides.title: OCUMEDA Website
slides.lede: Proposal for the design and Framer implementation of OCUMEDA's website restyling, based on the new CI: "Med-tech that radiates warmth", a clearer story on the main pages, and reusable Framer components that work across all pages.

items.title: The New CI
points: Colour, type and logo from the new CI, carried through the existing site.

items.title: Warm Med-tech
points: A close, human feeling: "Med-tech that radiates warmth".

items.title: A Clearer Story
points: Home, Ärzte, Optiker and Kunden tell a clearer story. Reusable Framer components work across all pages.

rows.value: Review of the CI, and feedback on storyline and structure
Existing Framer components updated and extended into a reusable set that works across all pages
Selected graphics updated with Ocumeda's halos
Content updates on Home, Ärzte, Optiker and Kunden
Checked across breakpoints. The responsive layout already exists.
Copy, photography and halo graphics are provided by Ocumeda. Copywriting and image production are not included.
Team, Karriere and Blog are not included. Standorte stays a placeholder.

hosting.disclaimer: The existing Framer hosting stays as it is and is not part of this proposal. The total is net, with no discount.
